lines: The man with the clipboard is called Trek. And he works at the Landing Office.
He opens a huge book. Your name is in it. Every landing, every skid mark, *every* sock.
Trek says: teleporters leave footprints in the air. Footprints... can be *followed*. By things that aren't friendly.
He hands you a ticket. One jump left on it. And no way to come back.
So what if your very next jump... *doesn't have a return*?
Follow and comment... for part four!
